tools.advanced.adminOnlyTitle.zh-CN: 高级设置供管理员使用

tools.advanced.description.en: For tools that aren't in the gallery. You'll need details from the tool's documentation. Most people never need this — if the app you want is in the gallery,
tools.advanced.description.zh-CN: 对于不在库中的工具。您需要该工具文档中的详细信息。大多数人永远不需要这个——如果你想要的应用在图库中，

tools.advanced.selectCompany.en: Select a company to open advanced setup.
tools.advanced.selectCompany.zh-CN: 选择一家公司以打开高级设置。

tools.agent.blockedToolsDescription.en: Tools the agent could name but Paperclip would block:
tools.agent.blockedToolsDescription.zh-CN: 智能体可以命名但 Paperclip 会阻止的工具：

tools.agent.effectiveAccessDescription.en: This is exactly the tool set Paperclip will accept for {{agent}}. Profile and policy edits are reflected within ~5 seconds. The agent's prompt can narrow this list but cannot expand it — everything else is blocked by default.
tools.agent.effectiveAccessDescription.zh-CN: 这正是 Paperclip 将接受 {{agent}} 的工具集。访问配置和策略编辑会在大约 5 秒内反映出来。智能体的提示可以缩小此列表，但不能扩展它——默认情况下，其他所有内容都会被阻止。

tools.agent.everyKnownToolAllowed.en: Every known tool this agent could name is allowed.
tools.agent.everyKnownToolAllowed.zh-CN: 该智能体可以命名的所有已知工具都是允许的。

tools.agent.installAccessExplanation.en: Has access means the app is permitted. Installed means its tools are added to this agent's runtime context.
tools.agent.installAccessExplanation.zh-CN: 具有访问权限意味着该应用已被允许。已安装意味着其工具已添加到该智能体的运行时上下文中。

tools.agent.installedAppsDescription.en: Installed apps load tools into {{agent}}'s context on every run. Permitted-only apps do not add context cost.
tools.agent.installedAppsDescription.zh-CN: 已安装的应用在每次运行时都会将工具加载到 {{agent}} 的上下文中。仅允许的应用不会增加上下文成本。

tools.agent.installedForEveryAgentDescri.en: Installed from the app page for every agent. Remove the all-agents install there.
tools.agent.installedForEveryAgentDescri.zh-CN: 从每个智能体的应用页面安装。删除那里安装的所有智能体。

tools.agent.installedHint.en: Has access — tick to load its tools into this agent's context.
tools.agent.installedHint.zh-CN: 有权访问 — 勾选可将其工具加载到该智能体的上下文中。

tools.agent.loadedIntoContext.en: Loaded into this agent's runtime context.
tools.agent.loadedIntoContext.zh-CN: 加载到该智能体的运行时上下文中。

tools.agent.noActivePolicies.en: No enabled policy currently mutates this agent's allow list.
tools.agent.noActivePolicies.zh-CN: 当前没有启用的策略会改变此智能体的允许列表。

tools.agent.noActiveProfile.en: No active profile applies to this agent, so it has no allowed tools.
tools.agent.noActiveProfile.zh-CN: 没有活动访问配置适用于该智能体，因此它没有允许的工具。

tools.agent.noAllowedTools.en: No tools are allowed for this agent. Bind a tool profile to grant access.
tools.agent.noAllowedTools.zh-CN: 该智能体不允许使用任何工具。绑定工具访问配置以授予访问权限。

tools.agent.noPermittedApps.en: No permitted apps yet. Bind an access profile to make apps available here.
tools.agent.noPermittedApps.zh-CN: 尚无允许的应用。绑定访问配置以使应用在此处可用。

tools.agent.permittedNotInstalled.en: Permitted but not installed — tools will not appear in runs.
tools.agent.permittedNotInstalled.zh-CN: 允许但未安装 - 工具不会出现在运行中。

tools.audit.description.en: What your agents actually did with your apps, newest first. Each line is one decision — allowed, blocked, asked first, waiting, or failed.
tools.audit.description.zh-CN: 您的智能体实际上对您的应用做了什么，最新的优先。每一行都是一个决定——允许、阻止、先询问、等待或失败。

tools.audit.details.deliveredMcpServers.zh-CN: 已交付 MCP 服务器

tools.audit.emptyDescription.en: As soon as your agents start using connected apps, what they do shows up here.
tools.audit.emptyDescription.zh-CN: 一旦您的智能体开始使用连接的应用，他们所做的事情就会显示在这里。

tools.audit.hideEventDetails.zh-CN: 隐藏 {{agent}} 的活动详细信息

tools.audit.immutabilityNotice.en: Recorded by Paperclip — entries can't be edited. Sensitive values are never stored.
tools.audit.immutabilityNotice.zh-CN: 由 Paperclip 录制 — 条目无法编辑。敏感值永远不会被存储。

tools.audit.noMatchingActivity.zh-CN: 没有活动与这些过滤器匹配

tools.audit.reasons.askedFirst.en: Held for someone to approve before it could run.
tools.audit.reasons.askedFirst.zh-CN: 在运行之前需要等待某人批准。

tools.audit.reasons.failed.en: The app was allowed to run it, but returned an error.
tools.audit.reasons.failed.zh-CN: 该应用被允许运行它，但返回了一个错误。

tools.audit.reasons.notInstalled.en: Permitted connections were not installed, so their tools were not added to this run.
tools.audit.reasons.notInstalled.zh-CN: 未安装允许的连接，因此他们的工具未添加到此运行中。

tools.audit.reasons.rateLimited.en: Blocked because it ran too many times in a short window.
tools.audit.reasons.rateLimited.zh-CN: 被阻止是因为它在短时间内运行了太多次。

tools.audit.reasons.secretBlocked.en: Blocked to keep a sensitive value from leaving.
tools.audit.reasons.secretBlocked.zh-CN: 阻止以防止敏感值离开。

tools.audit.reasons.waiting.en: Waiting — the app it needs wasn't ready yet.
tools.audit.reasons.waiting.zh-CN: 等待——它需要的应用还没有准备好。

tools.audit.runtimeDeliveryDiagnostic.en: {{agent}}'s run received 0 MCP servers — {{count}} permitted connection not installed
tools.audit.runtimeDeliveryDiagnostic.zh-CN: {{agent}} 的运行收到 0 个 MCP 服务器 — {{count}} 允许的连接未安装

tools.audit.showEventDetails.zh-CN: 显示 {{agent}} 的活动详细信息

tools.audit.tryDifferentFilters.en: Try a wider time window or different filters.
tools.audit.tryDifferentFilters.zh-CN: 尝试更宽的时间范围或不同的过滤器。

tools.connections.add.applicationTypeHin.en: Application type is inferred from the transport you choose next.
tools.connections.add.applicationTypeHin.zh-CN: 应用类型是根据您接下来选择的传输方式推断的。

tools.connections.add.commandTemplateHin.en: Only board-approved command templates can run. Arbitrary commands are never accepted.
tools.connections.add.commandTemplateHin.zh-CN: 只有看板批准的命令模板才能运行。绝不会接受任意命令。

tools.connections.add.description.en: Choose an existing application or create one as part of the same connection flow. Credentials stay as vault references and the connection is probed before activation.
tools.connections.add.description.zh-CN: 选择现有应用或创建一个应用作为同一连接流的一部分。凭证保留为保管库引用，并且在激活之前会探测连接。

tools.connections.add.probeLatencyHint.en: Probe latency is a single round-trip sample. Aggregate p95 latency across traffic is tracked on the Runtime tab once the connection is live.
tools.connections.add.probeLatencyHint.zh-CN: 探测延迟是单次往返样本。连接上线后，将在“运行时”选项卡上跟踪流量中的聚合 p95 延迟。

tools.connections.add.vaultReferenceHint.en: Free-text secrets are not accepted — pick a vault entry; Paperclip stores only the vault:// reference and resolves it at gateway use time.
tools.connections.add.vaultReferenceHint.zh-CN: 不接受自由文本机密 — 选择一个保管库条目； Paperclip 仅存储 vault:// 引用并在网关使用时解析它。

tools.connections.catalog.empty.en: No tools discovered yet. Use “Refresh catalog” to discover tools from this connection.
tools.connections.catalog.empty.zh-CN: 尚未发现任何工具。使用“刷新目录”可从此连接发现工具。

tools.connections.honcho.workspaceHint.en: Enter a workspace to include Honcho instructions. Existing tools remain available.
tools.connections.honcho.workspaceHint.zh-CN: 请输入工作区以包含 Honcho 指令。现有工具仍可继续使用。

tools.connections.secretRefPrefix.en: Free-text secrets are not accepted — pick a vault entry; Paperclip stores only the
tools.connections.secretRefPrefix.zh-CN: 不接受自由文本密钥，请选择密钥库条目；Paperclip 仅存储

tools.connections.secretRefSuffix.en: reference and resolves it at gateway use time.
tools.connections.secretRefSuffix.zh-CN: 引用，并在网关使用时解析。

tools.developer.description.en: Apps is the simple way to connect tools. This Developer area is for wiring your own servers, tokens, and rules by hand — most teams never need it.
tools.developer.description.zh-CN: 应用是连接工具的简单方式。该开发人员区域用于手动连接您自己的服务器、令牌和规则——大多数团队从不需要它。

tools.gateways.description.en: Stable endpoints for external clients that use the same profiles, rules, and audit trail as agent tool access.
tools.gateways.description.zh-CN: 使用与智能体工具访问相同的访问配置、规则和审计记录的外部客户端的稳定端点。

tools.gateways.empty.en: No named gateways yet. Create one here, then issue a token for the client that will connect to it.
tools.gateways.empty.zh-CN: 还没有命名网关。在此创建一个，然后为将连接到它的客户端发出一个令牌。

tools.gateways.form.descriptionPlacehold.en: Who this endpoint is for and when it should be rotated.
tools.gateways.form.descriptionPlacehold.zh-CN: 该端点适用于谁以及何时应轮换。

tools.gateways.form.profileRequired.en: Create an access profile before adding a gateway.
tools.gateways.form.profileRequired.zh-CN: 添加网关之前创建访问配置。

tools.gateways.toast.pickProfileBody.en: A gateway needs an access profile before it can be created.
tools.gateways.toast.pickProfileBody.zh-CN: 网关在创建之前需要一个访问配置。

tools.gateways.toast.pickTokenActionsBod.en: Gateway tokens need at least one allowed MCP action.
tools.gateways.toast.pickTokenActionsBod.zh-CN: 网关令牌至少需要一项允许的 MCP 操作。

tools.gateways.toast.tokenIssuedBody.en: {{name}} was created. Copy it now; it will not be shown again.
tools.gateways.toast.tokenIssuedBody.zh-CN: {{name}} 已创建。立即复制；它不会再次显示。

tools.gateways.token.clientLabelPlacehol.zh-CN: Cursor 在工作笔记本电脑上

tools.gateways.token.ownerNotePlaceholde.en: Who owns this token and why it exists
tools.gateways.token.ownerNotePlaceholde.zh-CN: 谁拥有这个代币以及它存在的原因

tools.pasteConfig.checkHint.en: We'll read it and show what we found before anything is saved.
tools.pasteConfig.checkHint.zh-CN: 在保存任何内容之前，我们将阅读它并显示我们发现的内容。

tools.pasteConfig.description.en: Paste the MCP config snippet from the tool's README and we'll turn it into a friendly setup.
tools.pasteConfig.description.zh-CN: 粘贴该工具自述文件中的 MCP 配置片段，我们会将其转换为友好的设置。

tools.pasteConfig.empty.en: We couldn't find an app in that config. Double-check you pasted the whole snippet.
tools.pasteConfig.empty.zh-CN: 我们在该配置中找不到应用。仔细检查您是否粘贴了整个片段。

tools.pasteConfig.invalidJson.en: That doesn't look like valid JSON yet — paste the whole snippet, including the outer braces.
tools.pasteConfig.invalidJson.zh-CN: 这看起来还不像有效的 JSON — 粘贴整个片段，包括外部大括号。

tools.pasteConfig.keysDraftOnly.en: Keys from this config stay draft-only until an admin maps them to an approved template.
tools.pasteConfig.keysDraftOnly.zh-CN: 此配置中的密钥仅保留草稿状态，直到管理员将它们映射到批准的模板。

tools.pasteConfig.localDraftHint.en: We humanized the field names from the config. These run-in-your-workspace tools stay as drafts until an admin maps them to an approved template.
tools.pasteConfig.localDraftHint.zh-CN: 我们将配置中的字段名称人性化。这些在工作区中运行的工具将保留为草稿，直到管理员将它们映射到批准的模板。

tools.pasteConfig.noKeys.en: No keys needed for this one.

tools.pasteConfig.pasteHint.en: Paste an MCP config — the snippet a README tells you to copy.
tools.pasteConfig.pasteHint.zh-CN: 粘贴 MCP 配置 - 自述文件告诉您复制的片段。

tools.pasteConfig.remoteCheckHint.en: Checking a remote app creates a draft connection, stores any header replacements as Paperclip secrets, and runs health/catalog discovery before activation.
tools.pasteConfig.remoteCheckHint.zh-CN: 检查远程应用会创建草稿连接，将任何标头替换存储为 Paperclip 机密，并在激活之前运行运行状况/目录发现。

tools.pasteConfig.remoteOnly.en: Only remote HTTP drafts can be checked and activated from pasted config.
tools.pasteConfig.remoteOnly.zh-CN: 只能从粘贴的配置中检查和激活远程 HTTP 草稿。

tools.pasteConfig.reviewHint.en: Health and catalog checks passed. Read-only actions start on; actions that can change data start off.
tools.pasteConfig.reviewHint.zh-CN: 健康状况和目录检查已通过。只读操作开始于；可以更改数据的操作开始。

tools.policies.approvals.description.en: When you approve an Ask-first request, Paperclip can remember the decision.
tools.policies.approvals.description.zh-CN: 当您批准“先询问”请求时，Paperclip 可以记住该决定。

tools.policies.confirm.deleteBody.en: This rule matched {{count}} times in the last 24 hours. Deleting it may change what agents can do.
tools.policies.confirm.deleteBody.zh-CN: 此规则在过去 24 小时内匹配了 {{count}} 次。删除后可能会改变智能体可执行的操作。

tools.policies.confirm.forgetBody.en: Paperclip will ask again the next time this action needs approval.
tools.policies.confirm.forgetBody.zh-CN: Paperclip 下次此操作需要批准时将再次询问。

tools.policies.description.en: Rules are checked top to bottom — the first one that matches decides.
tools.policies.description.zh-CN: 规则从上到下检查——第一个匹配的规则决定。

tools.policies.empty.description.en: Start with a template or create a rule from scratch.
tools.policies.empty.description.zh-CN: 从模板开始或从头开始创建规则。

tools.policies.onHint.en: Turn this off to keep the rule saved without matching.
tools.policies.onHint.zh-CN: 关闭此选项可以保存规则而不进行匹配。

tools.policies.simulator.description.en: Pick an agent and an action to see what Paperclip would do.
tools.policies.simulator.description.zh-CN: 选择一个智能体和一个操作，看看 Paperclip 会做什么。

tools.policies.starters.askFirst.zh-CN: 在选择操作之前先询问

tools.policies.toast.duplicatedBody.en: The copy is off until you turn it on.
tools.policies.toast.duplicatedBody.zh-CN: 在您将其打开之前，副本将处于关闭状态。

tools.policies.validation.limit.en: Limit must be a positive integer

tools.policies.validation.priority.en: Priority must be an integer from 0 to 10000
tools.policies.validation.priority.zh-CN: 优先级必须是 0 到 10000 之间的整数

tools.policies.validation.window.en: Window must be a positive number of seconds

tools.profiles.actions.archive.body.en: This profile stops applying to {{count}} agent(s). You can restore it later.
tools.profiles.actions.archive.body.zh-CN: 此访问配置停止应用于 {{count}} 智能体。您可以稍后恢复它。

tools.profiles.actions.delete.body.en: This permanently deletes the profile and removes {{count}} assignment(s).
tools.profiles.actions.delete.body.zh-CN: 这将永久删除访问配置并删除 {{count}} 分配。

tools.profiles.actions.delete.chooseDefa.en: Choose another access profile and make it the company default first.
tools.profiles.actions.delete.chooseDefa.zh-CN: 首先选择另一个访问配置并将其设为公司默认值。

tools.profiles.actions.delete.defaultBlo.en: This profile is the company default. Reassign the company default to another profile before deleting it.
tools.profiles.actions.delete.defaultBlo.zh-CN: 此访问配置是公司默认配置。在删除之前，将公司默认值重新分配给另一个访问配置。

tools.profiles.actions.restore.body.en: This profile will be active again and can be assigned to agents.
tools.profiles.actions.restore.body.zh-CN: 该访问配置将再次激活并可以分配给智能体。

tools.profiles.adminGate.description.en: Access profiles decide which tools your agents can use. Ask an administrator to set these up, or head back to
tools.profiles.adminGate.description.zh-CN: 访问配置决定您的智能体可以使用哪些工具。请管理员进行设置，或返回

tools.profiles.adminGate.title.zh-CN: 访问配置供管理员使用

tools.profiles.allowList.empty.en: This profile allows 0 tools. Agents with only this profile will not be able to use app tools.
tools.profiles.allowList.empty.zh-CN: 此访问配置允许 0 个工具。仅分配此配置的智能体将无法使用应用工具。

tools.profiles.allowList.patternWarning.en: Tools marked pattern were pulled in by a wildcard, application, connection, or risk selector rather than named explicitly — review them when the catalog changes.
tools.profiles.allowList.patternWarning.zh-CN: 标记模式的工具是通过通配符、应用、连接或风险选择器引入的，而不是明确命名的 - 当目录更改时检查它们。

tools.profiles.allowList.showing.zh-CN: 显示 80 个 {{count}} 允许的工具。

tools.profiles.allowList.total.zh-CN: 允许 {{allowed}} 或 {{total}} 已知工具。

tools.profiles.assign.defaultDescription.en: Every agent without its own profile uses this one.
tools.profiles.assign.defaultDescription.zh-CN: 每个没有自己的访问配置的智能体都会使用此访问配置。

tools.profiles.assign.makeDefault.zh-CN: 将此设置为公司默认值

tools.profiles.assign.moreTargetsHelp.en: Assign this profile to a whole project or a scheduled routine instead of (or as well as) individual agents.
tools.profiles.assign.moreTargetsHelp.zh-CN: 将此访问配置分配给整个项目或计划的例程，而不是（或以及）单个智能体。

tools.profiles.assign.overlapHelp.en: If an agent has several profiles, it can use anything any of them allows.
tools.profiles.assign.overlapHelp.zh-CN: 如果智能体有多个访问配置，则它可以使用其中任何一个访问配置允许的任何内容。

tools.profiles.assignments.emptyDescript.en: Assign this profile before it changes access.
tools.profiles.assignments.emptyDescript.zh-CN: 在更改访问权限之前分配此访问配置。

tools.profiles.checkAgentAccess.zh-CN: 检查智能体的访问权限

tools.profiles.checkAgentAccessDescripti.en: See exactly which tools an agent can use right now, and which profile allows each one.
tools.profiles.checkAgentAccessDescripti.zh-CN: 准确查看智能体现在可以使用哪些工具，以及每个访问配置允许使用哪些工具。

tools.profiles.description.en: Decide which tools your agents can use. Build a profile once, then assign it to the agents that need it.
tools.profiles.description.zh-CN: 决定您的智能体可以使用哪些工具。构建一次访问配置，然后将其分配给需要它的智能体。

tools.profiles.detail.archivedNotice.en: This profile is archived. It does not apply to agents until it is restored.
tools.profiles.detail.archivedNotice.zh-CN: 此访问配置已存档。在恢复之前它不适用于智能体。

tools.profiles.detail.assignBeforeActive.en: Assign it to agents before it changes their access.
tools.profiles.detail.assignBeforeActive.zh-CN: 在更改智能体的访问权限之前将其分配给智能体。

tools.profiles.detail.checkAgentAccess.en: Check what an agent can actually do
tools.profiles.detail.checkAgentAccess.zh-CN: 检查智能体实际上可以做什么

tools.profiles.detail.notFoundDescriptio.en: This access profile may have been deleted.
tools.profiles.detail.notFoundDescriptio.zh-CN: 此访问配置可能已被删除。

tools.profiles.dialog.descriptionPlaceho.zh-CN: 供审阅者选择的上下文。

tools.profiles.dialog.duplicateDescripti.en: The copy starts unassigned unless you choose to copy assignments too.

tools.profiles.dialog.editDescription.en: Update the profile name and description.
tools.profiles.dialog.editDescription.zh-CN: 更新访问配置名称和描述。

tools.profiles.dialog.legacyDescription.en: Profile rules are enforced by the tool gateway policy service.
tools.profiles.dialog.legacyDescription.zh-CN: 访问配置规则由工具网关策略服务强制执行。

tools.profiles.effective.noProfile.en: No active profile applies to this agent.
tools.profiles.effective.noProfile.zh-CN: 没有有效的访问配置适用于该智能体。

tools.profiles.effective.noTools.en: This agent cannot use any app tools right now.
tools.profiles.effective.noTools.zh-CN: 该智能体目前无法使用任何应用工具。

tools.profiles.effective.pickAgent.en: Pick an agent to see what it can use right now.
tools.profiles.effective.pickAgent.zh-CN: 选择一个智能体看看它现在可以使用什么。

tools.profiles.empty.description.en: Pick a starting point. You can fine-tune exactly which tools it allows in the next step.
tools.profiles.empty.description.zh-CN: 选择一个起点。您可以在下一步中精确调整它允许使用哪些工具。

tools.profiles.empty.title.zh-CN: 创建您的第一个访问配置

tools.profiles.emptyLegacy.description.en: Create a profile to group tool selectors, then bind it to the company or a specific agent.
tools.profiles.emptyLegacy.description.zh-CN: 创建访问配置以对工具选择器进行分组，然后将其绑定到公司或特定智能体。

tools.profiles.futureTools.allowedBody.en: New tools from selected apps become available right away.
tools.profiles.futureTools.allowedBody.zh-CN: 选定应用中的新工具立即可用。

tools.profiles.futureTools.allowedHint.en: Any tool an app adds later becomes usable right away.
tools.profiles.futureTools.allowedHint.zh-CN: 应用稍后添加的任何工具都可以立即使用。

tools.profiles.futureTools.blockedBody.en: New tools do not become available automatically.
tools.profiles.futureTools.blockedBody.zh-CN: 新工具不会自动变得可用。
